note: Andbank's book of tariffs (22 January 2026), read again on 2026-10-30 for every card in its cardholders' table except the Visa Electron debit cards: the Visa Open (52 euros a year to issue and hold), Visa Open Or (100), Visa Platinum (180 euros; 225 US dollars for one in dollars, not written), Visa Solidària (52), Visa Rotary (130; for Rotary members, not checked), Visa Viatge (48) and Visa 1,2,3 (48). Each: deferred payments carry 1.80% a month (24.24% TAE), and a purchase in a currency other than the euro 4.00%. The commission of 1% on the credit limit granted, at most 90 euros a half-year, isn't written, the game holding no card limit; the Platinum VIP's 1% on billing and the insurance, duplicate and SMS charges aren't written. The main banks: Andorra's three banking groups are Andbank, Crèdit Andorrà and MoraBanc; only Andbank's tariffs were read on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Visa Open (2026-10-29) holds and is kept. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): MoraBanc, the third of the three banking groups, was added; Crèdit Andorrà's site answered with a Cloudflare check ('Just a moment'), so it isn't written. MoraBanc's tariffs charged to clients (version 03/2025 of 10 October 2025, the current one its tariffs page links, IGI tax not included), read 30 October 2026: the Visa Crèdit at 68 euros a year, the Visa Gold 95 and the Visa Platinum 155 (the Jove and Funció Pública versions, free for the young and public servants, aren't written); a card in credit mode pays a deferral commission of 1.50% a month on the debt outstanding, written as the rate; cash at the bank's own machines or counters costs 3.35%, at least 2.50 euros (4.50%, at least 6, elsewhere, not written); each unpaid receipt costs 34 euros at the first claim, written as the late fee. The IGI on the fees isn't written, its rate not given in the tariffs; no foreign transaction fee, minimum payment or grace period is stated for the cards. No minimum payment is published for Andbank's seven Visa cards and MoraBanc's three; tried: Andbank's tariff book (22 January 2026) and MoraBanc's tariffs, read again 2026-10-30 (each prices deferred payment, neither states a least monthly payment), and archive.org's availability API (its snapshots can't be read: web.archive.org is refused by this environment's egress), which lists snapshots of both banks' home pages.
